**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The IP/data allocation in this Development and Option Agreement meets the fallback on its material terms and, on ownership direction, exceeds it:

- **Nothing of ours goes to Harpoon.** Section 7.1.1 gives each Party sole ownership of what it creates and of its background IP; Section 3.8.2(c) makes AbbVie the sole owner of all Regulatory Documentation, with Harpoon executing confirmatory assignments *to us*. Harpoon's only licence under AbbVie IP (Section 5.2) is non-exclusive, non-sublicensable and limited to what is necessary to perform its Initial Development Plan obligations, with Section 5.6.2 confirming no other grant — the "processing solely to provide the Services" analogue is satisfied.
- **Joint ownership is workable, not walk-away.** Section 7.1.2 pairs joint ownership with an express right to Exploit without consent or accounting; the only overlays are our own exclusive licences and Harpoon's exclusivity covenant, both of which favour us.
- **Our licence clears the fallback markers.** Worldwide (Territory = "the entire world"), Exploit rights, multi-tier sublicensing (5.3), and fully-paid, royalty-free, irrevocable on expiry (12.1.2).

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the licence is royalty-bearing/terminable during the Term (the priced commercial bargain), and the preferred "no joint ownership" outcome is not achieved. Redacted text in 7.1.2 and 12.7 could not be verified.
